items.title: 9.3 Digital ishtirak aur computing mein masawat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu of topic 9.3 (PDF 128-131), paragraph for paragraph; the inclusive-design figure, self-check and recap are ours.

blocks.text: Digital collaboration ka matlab hai technology ke zariye mushtarka (shared) kaamon, projects ya khayalat par mil kar kaam karna. Yeh logon ko internet ke zariye mukhtalif jagahon se jurne aur hissa dalne deta hai. Talaba seekhte hain ke digital mahol mein teamwork, communication (baat-cheet) aur zimmedari maqsad zyada behtar tareeqe se hasil karne mein kaise madad karte hain (Figure 9.3 dekhein).

Computing mein equity (insaf aur barabari) yaqeeni banati hai ke har koi, chahe us ka pas-e-manzar ya salahiyat kuch bhi ho, barabar shirkat kar sake aur digital wasail (resources) tak pohanch sake. Collaboration ko insaf ke saath milana sab ko shamil karne wala (inclusive) aur mo-assar parhai aur kaam ka mahol banata hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar muskurate talaba laptops ke saath aik mez par baithe hain; laptops ki pusht dekhne wale ki taraf hai. Upar aik cloud teen lakeeron se group se jura hai. Tasveer par koi label nahi.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.3: Digital ishtirak (collaboration) (kitab ki Figure 9.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Cloud aik mushtarka jagah hai jahan files online rakhi jati hain. Teen lakeerein dikhati hain ke chaaron talaba alag laptops se usi aik cloud se jure hain, is liye sab aik hi dastavez par aik saath kaam kar sakte hain.
Online mil kar kaam karna

Online mil kar kaam karna teams ko ek jagah hue baghair khayalat share karne, feedback (raye) dene lene aur kaam mukammal karne deta hai. Documents, discussions aur wasail tak mushtarka rasai se yeh cooperation (taawun) aur creativity barhata hai. Talaba samajhte hain ke wazeh communication aur ek doosre ki izzat kamyab online teamwork ki kunji hain. Digital collaboration seekhna unhein jadeed workplaces ke liye tayyar karta hai jahan remote work (door se kaam) aam hai. Online teamwork masle hal karne ki himmat afzai karta hai aur zaroori interpersonal skills (logon se milne julne ki salahiyat) banata hai.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: Jo teams wazeh baat-cheet karti hain woh kaam jaldi aur kam ghaltiyon ke saath mukammal karti hain.
Digital mahol mein teamwork aur communication ki ahmiyat

Digital mahol mein teamwork ke liye team members ke darmiyan wazeh communication aur bharosa zaroori hai. Jab har koi khayalat deta hai aur doosron ki sunta hai to projects aasani se chalte hain. Mo-assar communication ghalat-fehmiyan rokti hai aur yaqeeni banati hai ke sab members progress se bakhabar rahein. Group chats, emails aur video calls jaise tools teams ko jura rakhte hain. Achha teamwork maqsad hasil karne mein creativity, taawun aur mushtarka zimmedari barhata hai.
Real-time collaboration ke tools aur platforms

Real-time collaboration tools kai users ko ek hi waqt mein ek hi project par kaam karne dete hain. Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams aur Zoom jaise platforms documents share karna, chat karna aur online meeting karna aasan banate hain. Yeh tools teams ko kaam munazzam karne, files mil kar edit karne aur foran update rehne mein madad dete hain. Real-time collaboration sab ko ek page par rakh kar waqt bachata aur ghaltiyan kam karta hai. In platforms ka achha istemal teams ko digital mahol mein tez aur behtar kaam karne deta hai.
Equity aur accessibility ke liye design
Equity aur accessibility (sab ke liye rasai) ko saamne rakh kar design karna yaqeeni banata hai ke technology har koi use kar sake, un logon samet jin ki salahiyatein aur pas-e-manzar mukhtalif hain.

Equal access (barabar rasai) ka matlab hai ke har shakhs ko technology aur internet use karne ka ek jaisa mauqa mile. Is mein bharosemand devices, internet connection aur digital skills tak rasai shamil hai. Kuch logon ko mushkilat ho sakti hain, jaise disabilities (mazoori), zaban ki rukawat ya wasail ki kami. In masail ko samajhna developers aur idaron ko aise hal design karne mein madad deta hai jo har kisi tak pohanchein. Equal access yaqeeni banata hai ke digital duniya mein koi peeche na rahe. Accessible design, jo mazoor logon ke liye faida-mand hai, sab ke liye istemal aasan bana deta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab ka aakhri jumla "Accessible design; benefits people with disabilities improves usability for everyone" thora uljha hua chhapa hai. Matlab yeh hai: jo design mazoor logon ke liye faida-mand ho, woh har kisi ke liye istemal aasan bana deta hai (jaise subtitles shor wali jagah par sab ke kaam aate hain).

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Groups ek chhota kaam, jaise poster ki planning, mukammal karein aur saath saath wazeh online andaz ke messages likhne ki mashq karein.
Mukhtalif users ke liye inclusive applications banana

Inclusive applications mukhtalif qism ke users ki zarooratein poori karne ke liye design ki jati hain. Is mein aise features shamil ho sakte hain jaise nazar ki kamzori walon ke liye screen readers (screen ka text bol kar sunane wala software), videos ke liye subtitles ya kai zabanon ke options. Saada layout aur wazeh text bhi apps ko naye users ke liye aasan banate hain. Developers ko apne designs mukhtalif users ke saath test karne chahiyein ta ke sab ke liye accessibility yaqeeni ho. Inclusive digital tools banana barabari ko barhata hai aur user ka majmooi tajurba behtar karta hai.

blocks.alt: Chhe dabbe: Screen reader (nazar ki kamzori wale), Subtitles (videos ke saath matn), Kai zabanein (zaban ka intikhab), Saada layout (aasan istemal), Wazeh matn (parhne mein aasan), Users se testing (mukhtalif log aazmayein).
blocks.caption: Shamooliyat wali (inclusive) applications ki khoobiyan (is sabaq ke liye hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).

blocks.text: Mo-assar collaboration ki strategies

Mo-assar collaboration teams ko aasani se kaam karne aur kaam kamyabi se mukammal karne mein madad deta hai. Jab har koi apni zimmedariyan samajhta hai aur wazeh baat karta hai to teamwork mazboot hota hai. Planning, kaam munazzam karna aur khayalat share karna group projects ko bina uljhan aage barhate hain. Collaboration yeh bhi sikhata hai ke mukhtalif raye ka ehtram kaise karein aur ek mushtarka maqsad ki taraf kaise kaam karein. Neeche mo-assar collaboration ki aam strategies (tadabeer) hain.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Wazeh roles (kirdar), kaam ka intezam aur goals tay karna teamwork ki karkardagi barhate hain.
Roles tay karna

Wazeh roles har team member ko theek theek batate hain ke use kya karna hai. Ek shakhs research sambhal sakta hai, doosra maloomat munazzam kar sakta hai aur teesra aakhri presentation tayyar kar sakta hai.
Kaam sambhalna
Checklists ya timelines bana kar kaam sambhalna team ko sahi raste par rakhta hai aur deri se bachata hai.
Team ke goals tay karna
Mushtarka goals tay karna sab ko kaam ki ek simt (direction) deta hai aur taawun barhata hai. Jab roles aur goals wazeh hon to teamwork bohat aasan aur behtar ho jata hai.
Collaboration ke tajurbat par ghaur karna

Project mukammal karne ke baad talaba ke liye faida-mand hai ke sochein kya achha hua aur kya behtar ho sakta tha. Reflection (ghaur o fikr) team members ko taqat, jaise achhi communication, aur kamzoriyan, jaise deadline se reh jana, pehchanne deta hai.
Teamwork behtar karne ke liye guftagu

In tajurbat par guftagu talaba ko ghaltiyon se seekhne aur behtar team player banne mein madad deti hai. Reflection group members mein izzat aur samajh bhi barhata hai. Waqt ke saath yeh aadat mazboot teamwork aur zyada kamyab collaboration ki taraf le jati hai.

blocks.prompt: Aap ke chaar ke group ko online presentation banani hai. Batayein ke kirdaron, kaam ki fehrist aur mushtarka dastavez se kaam kaise munazzam karenge.
blocks.explanation: Har rukn ko kirdar dein (researcher, likhne wala, designer, pesh karne wala); kaam, zimmedar aur deadlines mushtarka checklist mein; slides aik mushtarka file mein jis ki edit rasai sirf team ko; progress dekhne ke liye mukhtasar video meeting; aur aakhir mein mil kar ghaur ke kya behtar ho.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Digital collaboration: internet se mushtarka kaam; equity: sab ke liye barabar rasai.
Wazeh communication; real-time tools (Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams, Zoom).
Inclusive design (screen readers, subtitles, kai zabanein); roles, tasks, goals, reflection aur guftagu.
